resources.title: Solidity Core Syntax Reference
resources.description: A one-page compiled reference pulling together data types, function visibility/mutability, the constructor, control flow, loops, modifiers, events, and the zero-address pattern — every syntax piece Chapter 5 introduces lesson by lesson, in one place so you're not hunting back through individual guides mid-contract.

resources.title: Token Standards Cheat Sheet: ERC-20 vs. ERC-721
resources.description: A side-by-side comparison of every required function, state variable, and event the course builds for both standards across Chapter 6's twelve ERC-20 lessons and two ERC-721 lessons, plus the real OpenZeppelin inheritance shortcut — built to pin up while writing either token type.

resources.title: Reentrancy Audit Checklist
resources.description: A real, step-by-step checklist for auditing any contract for reentrancy before calling it done: find every external call, verify checks-effects-interactions ordering, confirm a reentrancy guard is applied, and trace the attack path by hand — built directly from the exact fixes Chapter 10 teaches against the course's own vulnerable EtherStore contract.
